decks.notes: This Modern Jund Aggro deck focuses on generating early game pressure and disruption through cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Thoughtseize. It also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate to control the board while utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Wrenn and Six to generate card advantage and provide additional utility. The deck also includes a versatile sideboard option in Jegantha, the Wellspring to fit the companion requirement. The land base is optimized for consistency and mana fixing to ensure the deck can operate efficiently and effectively against a variety of opponents.

This Jund Aggro deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, while also applying pressure with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tarmogoyf. The deck also utilizes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate to control the board. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional value and mana fixing. The deck is designed to be fast and aggressive, aiming to close out games quickly through a combination of creature damage and disruption.

The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost spells and creatures to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with hand disruption spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, while also dealing direct damage with cards like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tarmogoyf to close out the game quickly. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive playstyle, with lands like Urza's Saga and Wooded Foothills providing flexibility and consistency.

This deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and played to create a powerful combo. By using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the player can tutor for specific creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to dominate the board. Additionally, the deck includes ways to generate value through sacrificing creatures with abilities like Blood Artist and utilizing cards that provide additional utility such as Endurance and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a streamlined strategy that combines synergy and aggression.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. It also utilizes a mix of planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to control the board and provide additional value. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker allows for extra creativity in generating tokens or drawing cards. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces while controlling the game with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and counterspells like Spell Pierce.

The main concept of this Combo - Hammer Time deck is to assemble the combo of Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Sigarda's Aid to equip huge creatures like Inkmoth Nexus or Kaldra Compleat with powerful equipment for a quick win. The deck includes support cards like Stoneforge Mystic, Giver of Runes, and Esper Sentinel to control the game and protect the combo pieces. Using cards like Urza's Saga and Emeria's Call, the deck aims to efficiently search for and play its key cards while applying pressure on the opponent.

The deck focuses on controlling the game using artifacts and counterspells, while also creating a strong board presence with Thopter tokens and equipment like Sword of the Meek and Shadowespear. Urza, Lord High Artificer is a key card that generates mana and card advantage, while Urza's Saga helps find important artifacts. Stoneforge Mystic can search for crucial equipment pieces, and Metallic Rebuke provides additional disruption. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by generating incremental advantages and overwhelming them with a combination of control and threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards that allow for card selection and graveyard synergy to quickly deploy powerful threats like Death's Shadow and Dragon's Rage Channeler. By combining aggression with disruption (Thoughtseize, Lightning Bolt) and graveyard recursion (Underworld Breach), the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its efficient threats and strong synergy between its cards. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional layer of versatility and consistency to the deck's game plan.

This aggressive Red Deck Wins archetype focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent. The deck includes a mix of efficient burn spells like Rift Bolt, Lightning Bolt, and Lava Spike, as well as creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear. The deck also includes land cards that provide additional damage like Sunbaked Canyon and Roiling Vortex. Boros Charm and Skullcrack are included to prevent opponents from gaining life. The deck aims to continually pressure the opponent and finish the game before they can stabilize or gain too much life.

The key concept of this deck is to use the combination of Amulet of Vigor, Primeval Titan, and various lands to generate a powerful ramping effect. By playing lands like Simic Growth Chamber and Golgari Rot Farm, the deck can untap lands and generate additional mana when Primeval Titan enters the battlefield. This allows for quick and explosive mana acceleration, which can lead to casting powerful spells or even winning the game with lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The deck also includes cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to further enhance the land-ramp strategy.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly build up +1/+1 counters on creatures and artifacts, using cards like Hardened Scales and Hangarback Walker. Arcbound Ravager and Walking Ballista are key threats that can become huge with the counters. Urza's Saga and Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp provide additional ways to generate counters. The Ozolith can store counters and transfer them when a creature dies. The deck also includes various lands for mana fixing and support cards like Welding Jar for protection. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful, rapidly growing creatures and artifacts.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements such as counterspells and removal spells to protect and support the powerful card "The One Ring." By combining card advantage and disruption to stall the game, the deck aims to eventually resolve "The One Ring" and use it to take over the game with its powerful effects. Additionally, the deck includes cards like "Through the Breach" to quickly put out high-threat creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn for additional pressure. The strategy revolves around setting up a strong board presence while hindering the opponent's ability to respond effectively.

The deck focuses on utilizing a mix of Goblin creatures and support cards to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and synergistic combinations. It includes key cards like Conspicuous Snoop and Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker to create powerful board states and generate strong value. The deck aims to quickly build up a threatening board presence while disrupting the opponent's strategy, ultimately leading to a swift victory through explosive creature-based gameplay.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying low-cost aggressive creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan with hand disruption and removal spells. By combining efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief with punishing spells like Terminate and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early and maintain control of the board throughout the game. Feigning Death and Undying Malice provide additional ways to protect and recur key creatures, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker offers a powerful finisher for closing out games.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters. Combining removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate with disruptive creatures allows for quick tempo swings in the player's favor. Cards like Undying Malice and Feign Death provide additional opportunities for value and resilience, while the inclusion of Blood Moon can catch opponents off guard and disrupt their mana base. This deck aims to be a fast-paced, disruptive force in the Modern format.

The main focus of this deck is to deal damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent's life total using burn spells, cheap aggressive creatures, and direct damage effects. With a low mana curve and access to powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Boros Charm, the goal is to put pressure on the opponent early and finish them off before they can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel and Skullcrack also prevents the opponent from gaining life or playing spells safely, ensuring a swift victory for the aggressive player.
